questions.topic: DAMS · FMGE Dec CT - Pathology systemic
questions.stemHtml: A 35-year-old female presented with anterior neck swelling. During childhood she was exposed to radiation. Histopathology of swelling is shown in image. which of the following is true about this condition?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) Shows psammoma bodies is a true statement. The image provided shows the characteristic histopathology of papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC). Papillary thyroid carcinoma is known for its distinctive features, including the presence of psammoma bodies. These are small, concentric, calcified structures that are highly specific to this type of cancer. The patient's history of childhood radiation exposure also strongly points to a diagnosis of PTC, as this is a major risk factor.
